findings.rationale: World-open ingress on the administrative shell port gives every routable address an interactive surface inside the trust boundary.
The administrator role is assumable by any in-account principal, so assumption is escalation rather than a configuration detail.
The internet-reachable host chains into the assumable administrator role: neither asset alone yields account takeover, the joined chain does.
An identity holding the wildcard policy can read every object in the public-read bucket: the chain spans two fixtures and neither fixture shows it alone.
